I like my body intact, thank you very much.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] on the topic of family traditions|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
'''Spiceloaf''' was a traditional [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] food. It consisted of dense meat that had been ground, spiced, and heated to order. The amount of heat depended on the tolerance of the diner.
